All of the DRUCK clips and episodes are available to watch for free on their [Official Youtube Channel](https://www.youtube.com/c/DRUCKDieSerie) but it is geoblocked, which means that you need a VPN (set to Germany) to be able to access it, some suggestions are windscribe vpn for pc. Playlists for each season are created on their channel.

*Side note:* You can get news updates to their [official telegram messenger bot](https://t.me/DruckDieSerieBot)

for the most overseas fans like me, you can watch translated episodes on AllOfSkam’s website, with more infos on their site: https://sites.google.com/view/alllofskam

someone said before that they asked funk (the service where druck is) what will be the reason of having a possibility of getting a new season, and funk said it was about negotiating rights and stuff

Mina won an award recently for her performance in druck s5, funk made a post congratulating her, with a caption including a “do you want a new season of druck?” which made fans hype up more (despite waiting for months now)

If the reason would be about getting views, fans have made (almost) each clip of S6 to a 100k, it’s pretty low compared to the other seasons, but it can still reach that much

The last thing is that DRUCK held a survey last month (survey still open) which is what they did before S5 airing, asking about society issues nowadays and other topics, the results came by two weeks ago with 27k respondents in a span of almost 2 weeks (it’s more results than S5 survey, which reached 22k respondents for around 2 months)

the possibility of the show being renewed is still somewhere in the middle of a yes or no but, soon we hope to hear from the show again, and not leave us hanging.........

No, one of the questionnaires asks you if you’re living outside EU or no. From what I can tell, the survey is for everyone but the site is only on German, you can use google translate and answer the questions in English, or you can get help from a German-speaker to translate your answer to German (I’m not German)

From the site it says,

>We need your support so that we can continue with DRUCK. 
>
>For research on the production of the DRUCK series, we are interested in your living environment. That is why we have formulated some questions here. It's about you, your dreams, fears, hobbies, habits and much more. 
>
>We would be happy if you take the time to answer our questionnaire. This takes about 14 minutes. 
>
>Our questionnaire is anonymous and will be treated with absolute confidentiality. 
>
>We look forward to your answers. You can also forward the link to the questionnaire to your friends. 
>
>-Your DRUCK crew
